subject: website
name: Hydra on Swarm
summary: Hydra on Swarm, a Swarm build of the open-source Hydra live-coding visual synth. It stays at Level 2: when it opens it loads hydra-synth from cdn.jsdelivr.net and p5.js from cdnjs.cloudflare.com with no integrity hash, code the CDNs can change at any time. It also loads Google Fonts and translation files from raw.githubusercontent.com.
